description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This is a critical leadership opportunity for a compassionate and skilled Registered Nurse ready to make a significant impact on patient care and staff development. We are looking to fill this role quickly, so prompt applications are highly encouraged.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of care, and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff. This role offers the chance to shape the future of nursing services within a dynamic and resident-focused setting, contributing directly to the well-being of our community.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience as a Director of Nursing or in a similar nursing leadership role within a skilled nursing facility
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and manage a diverse nursing team
Excellent clinical assessment, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.
